verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that Pulley publishes a live llms.txt at help.pulley.com that indexes Help Center articles, and several help articles are served as .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed at agent-readable docs. Coverage is limited to the end-user Help Center: the probe only shows the file's header, the docs-md index path returns 404, no OpenAPI spec was found, and Pulley does not document or promote this as an agent-facing feature. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the llms.txt/agent-docs offering, evidence of full llms.txt content depth (e.g. an llms-full.txt), agent-oriented developer/API docs or OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of agent usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://help.pulley.com/llms.txt # Pulley Help Center
